exposure: transplantation of low-quality frozen-thawed single blastocysts
cohort: 350 singleton live births following frozen-thawed single blastocyst transplantation
finding: Transplantation of poor-quality blastocysts did not affect the growth and development of offspring (0-3 years) compared to good-quality blastocysts.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean section was significantly higher in the poor-quality blastocyst group compared to the good-quality blastocyst group.
